title: Village tutorial ladder: Tam's tools -> team of 3 -> training -> gathering -> home + 3 creature beds -> sleep -> feed
_comment: Transcribed from ralph/GATE_F_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md section B (span), section D (RT-02), section E.1 (CB-02), section E.3 (S03 builds the tutorial home and three creature beds under the real economy, free_build OFF), section E.5 (navigation record at each of the eight main-chain objectives this segment crosses), section G (GF-03-VILLAGE-02, GF-18-MAP-01, GF-20-NIGHT-01/02, GF-14-COMBAT-02) and section H (0.1 Hz segment).
_comment_economy: Section E.3: 'The authoritative run keeps free_build OFF everywhere'. Nothing in this file touches the Settings toggle; the whole home and all three beds are paid for out of the twenty village harvest nodes walked below. The owner directive of 2026-08-23 -- 'the village gatherable budget must afford three beds before sign-up' -- is verified by actually paying it, and the flag assertions are where a shortfall shows.
_comment_catalogue: AMBIGUITY: the protocol does not enumerate S03's build-catalogue navigation (section E.3 step 2 enumerates X02's 2x2 lab structure, not S03's home). The focus counts below are derived from data/items/buildables.json's category order and build_menu.gd's CATEGORY_ORDER, and from build_menu.gd remembering the last category and piece per session. They are a transcriber's derivation, not the protocol's words, and a focus_move that does not land FAILs loudly rather than silently selecting the wrong piece.
_comment_answer_prompts: answer_prompts stays OFF on every walk, per the schema's rule.

steps.title: how this segment is entered

args.text: Section B: this segment's entry save is `S02-exit`. The three steps below are the handoff's own mechanics: the live save directory is emptied first so the title's Load list has exactly one non-empty slot and auto-focuses it (`title_screen.gd` focuses the FIRST non-empty slot), then slot 4 is seeded from the run directory, then the load is driven through the production title-screen Load path by synthetic input. Section B names the seed and the Load path; the wipe is not named there and is recorded here as an added mechanical step, needed because an autosave left in slot 0 would take the auto-focus and the segment would load the wrong state.

args.text: Section E.6.16: 'Play naturally through day->night->day at least twice in the journey (day is ~600 s): record the transition's continuity (no snap), night legibility with and without torch (GF-20), and dawn recovery.' AMBIGUITY RECORDED: section G triggers GF-20-NIGHT-01/02 on 'first natural nightfall ... wherever the journey is', which a script written before the run cannot locate. They are pinned here, at the evening before the sleep rung, as the first point in the journey where the in-game clock is expected to have reached night; if it is not night when they fire, the manifest's own `clock_hour` and `light` fields say so and that is the evidence.
